#658 · Ninja Pokémon

Greninja

Water Dark

Kalos · Generation 6

Greninja is a Water/Dark-type Ninja Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 40 kg. It evolves from Frogadier. Its highest base stat is Speed (122), with a base stat total of 530.
